## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` and `npx astro check` pass
- [ ] I looked at it on a phone-sized screen (360px wide), with no sideways scrolling, and in dark mode
- [ ] Any fact, number or product name is from a source I read, with a link and a date; made-up example numbers are labelled as examples
- [ ] New interactive parts work by touch and keyboard, and respect reduced motion
- [ ] New lessons have a quiz, takeaways and prerequisites (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] I agree my contribution is released under the project's licences (code MIT, lessons CC BY 4.0)
